summary: Revised comprehensive implementation plan for the ENTIRE Atrium ERP & CRM multi-vertical platform. Details the unified architecture supporting all 6 business verticals (Gym, Salon, Restaurant, Projects, Rentals, Education), dynamic category adaptation, all 8 core application modules (Dashboard, Members/Clients, Registrations, POS Shop, Scheduler, Finance/Staff, History, Settings), multi-facility switching, and lifetime voucher licensing.
